meta.title: GCSE Study
meta.description: Practise exam answers, get them marked against the mark scheme, and see them at full marks.

key.title: Your Claude API key
key.statusActiveSoon: Key active · forgets in under a minute
key.explain: Marking runs on your own Claude API key. It is sealed (encrypted) into this browser session only: never stored, never shown again, and forgotten after {idle} minutes without use, after {absolute} minutes at most, or when you close the browser.
key.tip: Tip: create a key just for this, with a low monthly spend limit. If you ever leave it on a shared computer, revoke it in the Claude Console.
key.label: Paste your key
key.console: Create a key in the Claude Console
key.needed: Add your Claude key to have this marked.

write.question: Type or paste the question
write.questionPlaceholder: How does the writer use language and structure to create tension?
write.answerPlaceholder: Begin here. Press Start on the stopwatch when you are ready.
write.footnote: To be marked against the {board} scheme for a {marks}-mark question.
write.keptLocal: Your writing stays in this tab only. Nothing is saved.

results.trackIntro: The examiner reads the whole answer, chooses the level that fits best, then a mark within it. Select a level to read what it asks for.
results.idealTitle: See your answer at full marks
results.idealBody: Your own essay, rewritten to score {max} / {max}, keeping your ideas and voice, with every change explained.
results.disclaimer: AI marking is a guide, not an official grade. Level descriptions are paraphrased from the board's specification.
results.draftScheme: This mark scheme is a draft and is still being checked.

ideal.intro: Built from your own ideas and quotations. Numbered passages show what changed.
